evidence.actual: AADSTS70008: The provided authorization code or refresh token has expired due to inactivity.
evidence.note: The artifact carries AADSTS70008 (expired). The developer reported AADSTS54005 (already redeemed). Both map to the same class: the code was rejected as expired or reused.

output.fix: Exchange the authorization code exactly once, right after the redirect (codes live about 10 minutes or less). Use the same redirect_uri and client_id as in the authorization request. Guard against double submission, such as React StrictMode effects firing twice, retries, or a page refresh that replays the callback URL. If the code was already used or has expired, start a new interactive authorization request and get a fresh code. Keep PKCE S256 as it is. It verified correctly.

alternatives.why_not: The code_verifier matches the S256 code_challenge (pkce check passed).
redirect_uri exactly matches a registered URI (redirect_uri check passed).

questions: The captured artifact shows AADSTS70008 (expired), but you reported AADSTS54005 (already redeemed). Is the capture from the same attempt as the error you saw? A double token-endpoint call would explain 54005.
